article.story: JOHNSON CITY, Tenn. -- — Tyran Mason’s 19 points helped East Tennessee State defeat Campbell 68-53 on Wednesday. Mason had seven rebounds for the Buccaneers (1-2). B.J. Ward shot 4 of 7 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 5 from the line to add 14 points. Rashawn Inglemon led the Fighting Camels (0-3) in scoring, finishing with 20 points. Lance Waddles added 15 points for Campbell. Led by 10 points from Mason before the break, East Tennessee State entered halftime tied with Campbell 25-25. East Tennessee State took the lead for what would be the final time on Ward’s 3-pointer with 16:23 remaining in the game. Up next East Tennessee State’s next game is Tuesday against Marshall on the road, and Campbell hosts South Carolina Upstate on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
